methodologyNotes: Roster covers fourteen standalone phono preamplifiers spanning entry-level MM-only budget boxes (U-Turn Pluto 2, Fluance PA10, ART DJPRE II) to full MM/MC audiophile and hybrid tube/solid-state units (Vincent PHO-701, NAD PP 4, Cambridge Audio Alva Duo), verified 2026-08-12 primarily against manufacturer product pages (Schiit, Pro-Ject, Rega, Cambridge Audio, U-Turn Audio, Musical Fidelity, Parasound, iFi, Emotiva, ART Pro Audio, Fluance, NAD) with dealer/review-site corroboration (TMR Audio, HiFi System Components, Darkside Vinyl) where a manufacturer page did not expose full technical specifications or US pricing; priceUsd is left null rather than estimated wherever no manufacturer or authorized-dealer USD figure could be directly confirmed (Pro-Ject Phono Box S3 B, Rega Fono MM Mk5, Musical Fidelity V90-LPS, iFi Zen Phono 3 which lists only GBP, ART DJPRE II, Graham Slee Gram Amp 2 SE which lists only GBP), and multi-value specs (per-mode gain, per-cartridge-type SNR/THD/capacitance) are joined into a single descriptive string per the scalar-only field rule rather than split into arrays.
